method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town10_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town kitchen, single game asset: 雙灶爐台 (BrickStove). Design: Kitchen stove of red brick with lime-plastered top, two arched fire mouths with ember glow, two embedded woks (one with wooden lid), rear chimney, back ledge with seasoning jars and firewood in front. Scale: 1.7 x 0.95 m body, 0.86 m working height, chimney to 2.2 m. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (warm cedar timber, blue-grey stone, celadon porcelain, red lacquer, restrained jade and ochre accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, entire object visible on a light grey seamless studio background with soft contact shadow. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
